Referenced only in Rand's thoughts. Told Rand that Egwene is not for him

appearances.whereabouts: Leading the group north from the Border into the Blight, then camping on a hilltop near lakes with broken towers
appearances.notable_actions: Leads the party past the borderpost into the Blight. Warns about dangers like the Stick. Sets a hard pace. Explains the nature of the Blight's dangers. Checks the horses. Has an intimate conversation with Nynaeve where he refuses her love because he has nothing but a sword and an unwinnable war. Remains awake on watch.
appearances.demeanor: Flat, emotionless, unaffected by heat or stench. Shows unexpected gentleness with Nynaeve but ultimately rejects her for her own good

appearances.whereabouts: Escorts the group to the Border with a hundred lances, then turns back to ride to Tarwin's Gap
appearances.notable_actions: Halts at the borderpost as commanded. Expresses frustration at being kept from battle and not being allowed into the Blight. Gives formal farewell to Lan. Rides east toward Tarwin's Gap.
appearances.demeanor: Unhappy, disgruntled, eager for battle, puzzled by Nynaeve's question about wanting to fight Trollocs

appearances.whereabouts: Leads forces from Fal Dara east toward the rising sun and Tarwin's Gap
appearances.notable_actions: Commands the column leaving Fal Dara at dawn. Rides with the Black Hawk banner and Three Foxes. Planned with Moiraine for Ingtar to escort only to the Border.
appearances.demeanor: Purposeful, armored and ready for battle

appearances.whereabouts: Riding north through the Blight with the group, camping on hilltop near corrupted lakes
appearances.notable_actions: Observes the towers and the corruption of the Blight. Nearly touches poisoned leaves but stops. Helps unsaddle horses. Experiences fear when the camp seems to disappear due to Moiraine's bending. Watches Nynaeve and Lan's conversation. Tells Egwene he'd like being her Warder. Cannot sleep despite weariness.
appearances.demeanor: Observant, cautious, affected by the heat and stench, lost in Egwene's eyes, troubled by Min's words

appearances.whereabouts: Riding through the Blight with the group to the hilltop camp
appearances.notable_actions: Takes off his coat, openly displays the dagger. Gets sick multiple times from the Blight's stench, vomiting repeatedly. Wants to camp by the lakes until seeing the creature. Helps with horses. Runs into Rand when camp disappears. Makes jokes despite danger.
appearances.demeanor: Sick, physically affected by the Blight worse than others, still making poorly-timed comments, attempting humor

appearances.whereabouts: Leading the group north into the Blight to find the Eye of the World
appearances.notable_actions: Takes them north despite Lan's reluctance. Explains the signal towers. Decides to camp at the corrupted towers/lakes. Sets guarding wards around the hill. Creates a bending to hide their lights from watchers. Warns about dangers of untrained use of the One Power. Promises to find work for the young people in Tar Valon. Puts something in lamp oil to dispel the stench.
appearances.demeanor: Determined, strategic, physically affected by the Blight (tight eyes, pale lips) but pushing forward, protective

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling through the Blight with the group, camping on the hilltop
appearances.notable_actions: Suggests camping by lakes (before seeing creature). Scolds Mat. Declares intention to go to Tar Valon with Egwene. Brings tea to Lan and confesses her love for him, essentially proposing marriage. Told she deserves better than widow's black. Cries after Lan leaves.
appearances.demeanor: Determined not to show illness before Moiraine. Vulnerable and emotionally open with Lan. Hurt and crying after rejection.

appearances.whereabouts: Riding through the Blight, camping on hilltop
appearances.notable_actions: Takes off her cloak due to heat. Fills tea kettle. Shows excitement about possibly doing the bending trick. Laughs and invites everyone to come to Tar Valon together. Asks Rand to be her Warder when she becomes Aes Sedai.
appearances.demeanor: Bright-eyed, enthusiastic, hopeful, wanting reassurance from Rand, humming despite the horrors around them

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling through the Blight with the group
appearances.notable_actions: Still wears his coat unlike others. Breathes easily despite the heat. Glares at the corrupted forest as an enemy. Caresses his axe unconsciously. Mutters and half-growls. Gets his axe out when camp disappears then looks abashed. Snorts at Egwene's eagerness.
appearances.demeanor: Angry, fierce, affected differently by the Blight than others, golden eyes glowing, more like a predator than frightened

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling through the Blight, camping on hilltop
appearances.notable_actions: Opens his tunic and shirt due to heat. Wraps scarf around nose and mouth. Expresses outrage at corruption of trees. Sets up Lan's stove deftly. Takes out a book. First to go to sleep. Snores loudly.
appearances.demeanor: Uncomfortable with heat and damp, disgusted and outraged by corruption of nature, apologetic about discomfort

appearances.notable_actions: Moiraine dismounts from Aldieb to set wards

appearances.whereabouts: In the Blight with the group
appearances.notable_actions: Rand takes her reins to help unsaddle

appearances.notable_actions: Leads forces from Fal Moran with his sons at his side

relationships.description: Moiraine holds the Warder bond with Lan

Nynaeve confesses love and essentially proposes to Lan, who admits he will hate whoever she chooses and love him if he makes her smile, but refuses her because all he has is a sword and an unwinnable war
Egwene invites Rand to be her Warder when she becomes Aes Sedai, looking for reassurance; Rand agrees but is troubled by Min's words that they are not for each other
Ingtar serves under Lord Agelmar's command and follows his orders
Childhood friends traveling together, share looks of disbelief at lake creature
Nynaeve plans to accompany Egwene to Tar Valon to advise her and provide a familiar face
Moiraine is teaching Egwene about the One Power and plans to take her to Tar Valon for training
